scope: All 46 Western Crew person-card copies, plus persistent historical accuracy rule for all future Western rendering
period_policy: Working assumption: documented Old West roster spanning roughly 1865–1900, with individual dates; user was asked whether strict circa 1880 was preferred and has not selected it.
standard: Role and identity supported by date- and place-specific evidence.
Actual saved mesh inspected; prompts alone are not the delivered asset.
Clothing and equipment references distinguished from identity evidence.
Fictional composites receive occupational history, never fabricated individual biography.
Uncertain likeness, colors, costume combinations and small props remain expressly disclosed.
Retain is a researched plausibility decision, not certification of every visible detail.
Eight initial mandatory corrections require new static mesh verification before gallery promotion.
history_delivery: Every character has optional-to-open History in review gallery; factual content and sources mandatory. No gameplay integration before approval of all 46.
user_directed_replacement_policy: Replace unsupported fictional demographic choices with white male alternatives; preserve documented people and supported archetypes. This is a creative direction for fictional assets, not a claim of historical impossibility.
